completion: Under Section 43B(h), payments to micro and small enterprises are deductible only when paid. The time limit is 45 days from acceptance, or 15 days if there is no written agreement. I can only help with GST, payroll, invoice matching, and ERP operations, so I can't help with the other part of your question.

prompt: Translate hello into Tamil and tell me the professional tax cap.
completion: Professional tax is capped at Rs 2,500 per year. It is state-specific, and some states such as Delhi and Uttar Pradesh do not levy it. I can only help with GST, payroll, invoice matching, and ERP operations, so I can't help with the other part of your question.

prompt: आज का मौसम कैसा है और GSTR-3B कैसे फाइल करें?
completion:
GSTR-3B मासिक फाइलर के लिए अगले महीने की 20 तारीख तक देय है।
1. GST पोर्टल पर लॉगिन करके Returns Dashboard में अवधि चुनें।
2. Table 3.1 और Table 4 (ITC, GSTR-2B से मिलान करके) भरें।
3. टैक्स देयता का भुगतान करें।
4. EVC या DSC से फाइल करें। मैं केवल GST, पेरोल, इनवॉइस मैचिंग और ERP संचालन में मदद कर सकता हूँ, इसलिए आपके प्रश्न के दूसरे हिस्से में मैं मदद नहीं कर सकता।

prompt: कोई अच्छी फिल्म बताओ और ई-वे बिल की सीमा क्या है?
completion: ई-वे बिल तब आवश्यक है जब माल का मूल्य Rs 50,000 से अधिक हो। सामान्य माल के लिए वैधता हर 200 km पर 1 दिन है। मैं केवल GST, पेरोल, इनवॉइस मैचिंग और ERP संचालन में मदद कर सकता हूँ, इसलिए आपके प्रश्न के दूसरे हिस्से में मैं मदद नहीं कर सकता।

prompt: IPL कौन जीता और EPF में कर्मचारी का योगदान कितना है?
completion: EPF में कर्मचारी का योगदान वेतन का 12% है और नियोक्ता का भी 12% है। नियोक्ता के हिस्से में 8.33% EPS में और 3.67% EPF में जाता है। मैं केवल GST, पेरोल, इनवॉइस मैचिंग और ERP संचालन में मदद कर सकता हूँ, इसलिए आपके प्रश्न के दूसरे हिस्से में मैं मदद नहीं कर सकता।

prompt: आज का सोने का भाव बताओ और Form 16 कब जारी होता है?
completion: Form 16 वित्तीय वर्ष समाप्त होने के बाद 15 जून तक कर्मचारियों को जारी करना अनिवार्य है। मैं केवल GST, पेरोल, इनवॉइस मैचिंग और ERP संचालन में मदद कर सकता हूँ, इसलिए आपके प्रश्न के दूसरे हिस्से में मैं मदद नहीं कर सकता।

prompt: Our sales manager stayed 3 nights in a Pune hotel for a client visit. Can we take ITC on the hotel bill?
completion: Yes, if the hotel invoice carries your company's GSTIN, the stay is for business, and it appears in GSTR-2B (Section 16(2)). Hotel accommodation is not a blocked credit under Section 17(5). Claim it in GSTR-3B Table 4(A)(5).

prompt: Employee booked a hotel himself and the invoice is in his name with no company GSTIN. Can we claim ITC on the reimbursement?
completion: No. Section 16 needs a tax invoice issued to your company on its GSTIN. An invoice in the employee's name does not support ITC, so book the reimbursed amount, including GST, as a travel expense. Ask staff to quote the company GSTIN at booking.

prompt: Is ITC available on air tickets booked for our directors flying to a client meeting?
completion: Yes, on the GST charged in the airline invoice, if the ticket is booked on your GSTIN, the travel is for business, and the invoice appears in GSTR-2B. Personal travel is not eligible.

prompt: Company paid for LTC flight tickets for employees' family holiday. Can we claim the GST as ITC?
completion: No. Section 17(5)(b)(iii) blocks ITC on travel benefits extended to employees on vacation, such as leave or home travel concession. Book the GST as part of the cost.

prompt: I am a doctor running a clinic with fees of Rs 45 lakh a year. Do I need GST registration?
completion: No. Healthcare services by a clinical establishment or an authorised medical practitioner are exempt from GST. A person supplying only wholly exempt services is not liable to register under Section 23(1)(a).

prompt: We bought gym and fitness centre membership for staff at 18% GST. Is the ITC allowed?
completion: No. Section 17(5)(b)(iii) blocks ITC on membership of a club, health and fitness centre, unless the law makes providing it obligatory for the employer. Treat the GST as an expense.

prompt: Employer pays Rs 18,000 group mediclaim premium for each employee. Is it a taxable perquisite for employees?
completion: No. A premium paid by the employer on the employee's health insurance is not taxable as a perquisite, so there is no TDS under Section 192 on it for FY 2025-26 (Income-tax Act, 1961). The employer deducts it as a business expense.

prompt: कर्मचारियों का ग्रुप मेडिक्लेम प्रीमियम कंपनी भरती है। क्या यह कर्मचारी के लिए टैक्सेबल पर्क्विजिट है?
completion: नहीं। नियोक्ता द्वारा कर्मचारी के स्वास्थ्य बीमा पर भरा गया प्रीमियम पर्क्विजिट के रूप में कर योग्य नहीं है, इसलिए FY 2025-26 (Income-tax Act, 1961) में इस पर Section 192 के तहत TDS नहीं कटता। नियोक्ता इसे व्यावसायिक खर्च के रूप में कटौती में ले सकता है।

prompt: Our district cricket club got Rs 5,00,000 sponsorship from a private limited company. Who pays the GST?
completion: Sponsorship is a service by the club. When the sponsor is a body corporate, GST at 18% is payable by the sponsor under reverse charge, so the club does not charge tax. If the sponsor is an individual, the club charges 18%: Rs 5,00,000 x 18% = Rs 90,000.

prompt: Film production company paid Rs 5,00,000 advance to a studio rental vendor before the shoot. Is GST due on the advance and can we claim ITC now?
completion: For services, GST is payable by the vendor on the advance (Section 13(2), time of supply is the earlier of invoice or payment), with a receipt voucher. You can claim ITC only after you receive the tax invoice and it appears in GSTR-2B (Section 16(2)).

prompt: Our film production house licenses a film to a distributor in the UK and gets paid in USD. Is this an export of services?
completion: It qualifies if the recipient is outside India, the place of supply is outside India (Section 13(2) IGST Act, recipient's location), payment is in convertible foreign exchange, and the parties are not merely establishments of a distinct person. It is zero-rated under Section 16 IGST Act: supply under LUT without tax, or pay IGST and claim refund. Report in GSTR-1 Table 6A.

prompt: Production house pays Rs 3,00,000 fee to a film actor in FY 2025-26. What TDS applies?
completion: Section 194J (Income-tax Act, 1961, FY 2025-26): fees to film artists are professional fees, with TDS at 10% once payments exceed Rs 50,000 in the year. Rs 3,00,000 x 10% = Rs 30,000. Deposit by the 7th of the next month.

prompt: Restaurant under composition scheme: can we show GST separately on the customer bill?
completion: No. Under Section 10(4) a composition dealer cannot collect tax from the customer and must issue a bill of supply, not a tax invoice. You pay 5% of turnover (restaurants not serving alcohol), reported in CMP-08 quarterly and GSTR-4 annually. Customers get no ITC.

prompt: रेस्टोरेंट कंपोजिशन स्कीम में है। क्या ग्राहक के बिल पर GST अलग से दिखा सकते हैं?
completion: नहीं। Section 10(4) के तहत कंपोजिशन डीलर ग्राहक से टैक्स नहीं वसूल सकता और उसे टैक्स इनवॉइस की जगह बिल ऑफ सप्लाई जारी करना होता है। आप टर्नओवर का 5% (शराब न परोसने वाले रेस्टोरेंट) CMP-08 में तिमाही और GSTR-4 में वार्षिक रूप से भरते हैं। ग्राहक को ITC नहीं मिलता।

prompt: A restaurant serving liquor wants to opt for the 5% composition rate for restaurants. Is that allowed?
completion: No. The 5% composition rate is for restaurants that do not serve alcoholic liquor for human consumption. A restaurant serving liquor must remain a regular registered taxpayer and charge GST on its supplies.

prompt: Restaurant adds 10% service charge on a Rs 2,000 food bill. Is GST charged on the service charge?
completion: Yes. Service charge is part of the consideration under Section 15. Taxable value = Rs 2,000 + Rs 200 = Rs 2,200. For a standalone restaurant charging 5%, GST = Rs 2,200 x 5% = Rs 110.

prompt: Our JEE coaching institute charges Rs 60,000 per student. Are our fees exempt as education services?
completion: No. The exemption covers educational institutions only up to higher secondary level and certain approved courses. A coaching institute is not covered, so fees are taxable at 18%: Rs 60,000 x 18% = Rs 10,800 per student. Registration is needed above the Rs 20 lakh services threshold.

prompt: हमारा कोचिंग संस्थान प्रति छात्र Rs 60,000 फीस लेता है। क्या शिक्षा सेवा के रूप में यह छूट प्राप्त है?
completion: नहीं। छूट केवल उच्चतर माध्यमिक स्तर तक के शैक्षणिक संस्थानों और कुछ स्वीकृत पाठ्यक्रमों पर है। कोचिंग संस्थान इसमें शामिल नहीं है, इसलिए फीस पर 18% GST लगता है: Rs 60,000 x 18% = Rs 10,800 प्रति छात्र।

prompt: Is the children education allowance of Rs 100 per month still tax-free for an employee under the new regime?
completion: No. The exemption of Rs 100 per month per child (up to two children) under Section 10(14) of the Income-tax Act, 1961, and the Rs 300 hostel allowance, are available only in the old regime for FY 2025-26. Under the new regime they are fully taxable.

prompt: Employee took LTC for a family flight to Kerala. How much is exempt and in which regime?
completion: Section 10(5) (Income-tax Act, 1961, FY 2025-26): LTC exemption is available only in the old regime, for 2 journeys in a block of 4 years within India. For air travel, the exempt amount is limited to the economy fare of the national carrier by the shortest route.

prompt: We reimbursed Rs 9,000 visa fee for an employee's Singapore client trip. Is this taxable salary?
completion: No. Reimbursement of visa fees for official travel supported by receipts is a business expense, not salary or perquisite, so no TDS under Section 192 (1961 Act) applies. If the trip is personal, the reimbursement is taxable salary.

prompt: Visa agent invoiced Rs 2,000 service fee plus 18% GST and Rs 6,000 embassy fee for director's business trip. What ITC is available?
completion: ITC is available only on the agent's service fee GST: Rs 2,000 x 18% = Rs 360, if the invoice carries your GSTIN and it appears in GSTR-2B. The embassy fee, if billed as a pure agent under Rule 33, carries no GST and so no ITC.

prompt: Can we claim ITC on restaurant bills for a client dinner?
completion: No. Food and beverages and outdoor catering are blocked under Section 17(5)(b), unless the outward supply is of the same category or the law makes providing it obligatory. Book the full bill as an expense and do not claim ITC.

prompt: Employer gave each employee a Diwali gift hamper worth Rs 60,000 in FY 2025-26. Is GST applicable?
completion: Yes. Under Schedule I, gifts by an employer to an employee up to Rs 50,000 in a financial year are not a supply. Above Rs 50,000 in the year, the gift is treated as a supply and GST applies.

prompt: Can we claim ITC on sweets bought to gift our customers at Diwali?
completion: No. Section 17(5)(h) blocks ITC on goods given away as gifts or free samples. Do not claim it, and reverse any ITC already taken in GSTR-3B.

prompt: Our private limited company paid Rs 2,00,000 to a sports club for tournament sponsorship. Is RCM applicable and can we claim ITC?
completion: Yes. Sponsorship services to a body corporate are under reverse charge: 18% x Rs 2,00,000 = Rs 36,000, paid in cash and shown in GSTR-3B Table 3.1(d). Claim the same as ITC in Table 4(A)(3) if used for business and not blocked by Section 17(5). Issue a self-invoice.

prompt: हमारी प्राइवेट लिमिटेड कंपनी ने खेल क्लब को टूर्नामेंट स्पॉन्सरशिप के लिए Rs 2,00,000 दिए। क्या RCM लागू है?
completion: हाँ। बॉडी कॉर्पोरेट को दी गई स्पॉन्सरशिप सेवा पर रिवर्स चार्ज लागू है: 18% x Rs 2,00,000 = Rs 36,000, जो नकद में चुकाकर GSTR-3B Table 3.1(d) में दिखाना है। व्यवसाय के लिए उपयोग होने पर वही राशि Table 4(A)(3) में ITC के रूप में ली जा सकती है। सेल्फ-इनवॉइस जारी करें।

prompt: Exporting sales vouchers from Tally to CSV for GSTR-1. Which columns do we need for B2B invoices?
completion: Each B2B row needs: recipient GSTIN, invoice number, invoice date, invoice value, place of supply, reverse charge Y/N, invoice type, rate, taxable value, IGST/CGST/SGST amounts and cess. Each GSTIN must be 15 characters and invoice numbers at most 16 characters (Rule 46). CSV tax totals must equal the output tax ledgers.

prompt: Tally purchase register CSV vs GSTR-2B download: which fields should I match on?
completion: Match on supplier GSTIN, invoice number (cleaned of spaces and symbols) and invoice date, then compare taxable value and IGST/CGST/SGST. Classify each row as matched, amount mismatch, in books but not in 2B, or in 2B but not in books. Claim ITC only on rows present in GSTR-2B (Section 16(2)(aa)).

prompt: We are migrating from Tally using CSV exports. In what order should masters and balances be loaded?
completion:
1. Chart of accounts and ledger groups.
2. Party masters with GSTIN and state.
3. Item masters with HSN, unit and tax rate.
4. Opening trial balance (total debits must equal total credits).
5. Bill-wise open invoices.
6. Compare the new trial balance and closing ITC with Tally.

prompt: Tally से CSV एक्सपोर्ट करके नए ERP में डेटा माइग्रेट कर रहे हैं। मास्टर और बैलेंस किस क्रम में लोड करें?
completion:
1. चार्ट ऑफ अकाउंट्स और लेजर ग्रुप।
2. GSTIN और राज्य के साथ पार्टी मास्टर।
3. HSN, यूनिट और टैक्स रेट के साथ आइटम मास्टर।
4. ओपनिंग ट्रायल बैलेंस (कुल डेबिट और कुल क्रेडिट बराबर हों)।
5. बिल-वार बकाया इनवॉइस।
6. नए ट्रायल बैलेंस और क्लोजिंग ITC का Tally से मिलान करें।

prompt: Our turnover is Rs 12 crore and we are comparing ERP packages for GST. Which GST capabilities must it have?
completion: It must support: e-invoicing with IRN and QR (mandatory above Rs 5 crore), IRP reporting within 30 days (limit for Rs 10 crore and above), e-way bill above Rs 50,000, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data export, GSTR-2B reconciliation, HSN summary, reverse charge, Section 17(5) blocked-credit flags, and credit notes within the Section 34 deadline.

prompt: Small trader on QRMP evaluating accounting software. What GST features are needed?
completion: QRMP (turnover up to Rs 5 crore) needs: quarterly GSTR-1 by the 13th with optional IFF for the first two months, monthly tax payment challan (PMT-06) by the 25th, quarterly GSTR-3B by the 22nd or 24th by state, HSN summary, and monthly GSTR-2B reconciliation to protect ITC.

prompt: Can we claim ITC on food served in our factory canteen?
completion: No, in general. Section 17(5)(b) blocks ITC on food and beverages. The exception is where providing the canteen is obligatory under a law such as the Factories Act, in which case ITC on that canteen supply is allowed.

prompt: Company pays Rs 80,000 fee to a visiting doctor for employee health camps in FY 2025-26. Is TDS required?
completion: Yes. Section 194J (Income-tax Act, 1961, FY 2025-26): fees for professional services such as medical services attract TDS at 10% when payments exceed Rs 50,000 in the year. Rs 80,000 x 10% = Rs 8,000.

prompt: कंपनी ने FY 2025-26 में कर्मचारियों के हेल्थ कैंप के लिए विज़िटिंग डॉक्टर को Rs 80,000 फीस दी। क्या TDS कटेगा?
completion: हाँ। Section 194J (Income-tax Act, 1961, FY 2025-26) के तहत चिकित्सा जैसी पेशेवर सेवाओं की फीस पर, वर्ष में भुगतान Rs 50,000 से अधिक होने पर, 10% TDS लगता है। Rs 80,000 x 10% = Rs 8,000।

prompt: Employee travels to another city for a client meeting and gets Rs 6,000 travel allowance against Rs 5,000 actual spend. How is it taxed?
completion: Section 10(14)(i) exempts travel allowance only to the extent of actual expenditure on official duty, in both regimes. Exempt: Rs 5,000. The unspent Rs 1,000 is taxable salary and goes into TDS under Section 192 (1961 Act).

prompt: कर्मचारी क्लाइंट मीटिंग के लिए दूसरे शहर गया। उसे Rs 6,000 यात्रा भत्ता मिला जबकि वास्तविक खर्च Rs 5,000 हुआ। टैक्स कैसे लगेगा?
completion: Section 10(14)(i) के तहत यात्रा भत्ता केवल आधिकारिक कार्य के वास्तविक खर्च तक छूट प्राप्त है, दोनों रिजीम में। छूट: Rs 5,000। बिना खर्च हुआ Rs 1,000 वेतन के रूप में कर योग्य है और उस पर Section 192 (1961 Act) के तहत TDS लगेगा।

prompt: Medical store returned expired stock worth Rs 40,000 plus GST to the distributor, who accepted. What document is needed?
completion: The distributor issues a credit note under Section 34 and reports it in GSTR-1, and you reverse the ITC on it. The credit note must be issued by 30 November following the financial year or the date of annual return, whichever is earlier.

prompt: Medical store wrote off expired medicines the distributor will not take back. What happens to the ITC?
completion: Section 17(5)(h) blocks ITC on goods destroyed, written off, lost or stolen. Reverse the proportionate ITC in GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(2) for the month of write-off.

prompt: Cricket club sells merchandise worth Rs 35 lakh and runs coaching worth Rs 12 lakh a year. Does it need GST registration?
completion: Yes. A supplier of both goods and services is tested against the Rs 20 lakh threshold, not Rs 40 lakh. Aggregate turnover is Rs 35 lakh + Rs 12 lakh = Rs 47 lakh, above the limit in a non-special category state, so registration under Section 22 is required.

prompt: Film crew member earns Rs 18,000 gross a month and the production house is ESI-covered. What are the ESI contributions?
completion: ESI applies as wages are within Rs 21,000. Employee 0.75% x Rs 18,000 = Rs 135. Employer 3.25% x Rs 18,000 = Rs 585. Total Rs 720 per month.

prompt: Cricket club coach is paid Rs 20,000 gross a month and the club is ESI-registered. Calculate ESI.
completion: Gross wages are within Rs 21,000, so ESI applies. Employee 0.75% x Rs 20,000 = Rs 150. Employer 3.25% x Rs 20,000 = Rs 650. Total Rs 800 per month.

prompt: Restaurant waiter gets Rs 22,000 gross a month including tips share. Is ESI deducted?
completion: No. ESI applies only to employees whose gross wages are up to Rs 21,000 per month (Rs 25,000 for persons with disabilities). At Rs 22,000, this employee is outside ESI coverage.

prompt: Production company hired a lighting technician on a 14-month fixed-term contract. Is he eligible for gratuity?
completion: Yes. Under the labour codes in force since 21 Nov 2025, a fixed-term employee is eligible for gratuity after 1 year of service. Formula: last drawn wages x 15/26 x completed years. At 14 months, completed years = 1.

prompt: How do we match employee airline and hotel expense claims against vendor invoices in GSTR-2B?
completion: Match each claim to the vendor invoice on supplier GSTIN, invoice number, date and amount. ITC is allowed only where the invoice carries your company GSTIN, the trip is for business, and the invoice appears in GSTR-2B. Claims without a matching GSTIN invoice go to expense with GST included.

prompt: Hotel invoice for our team carries a wrong GSTIN for our company. Can we still take ITC?
completion: No. ITC needs an invoice issued to your GSTIN. The hotel must amend it in its GSTR-1 (amendment table) so the corrected invoice shows in your GSTR-2B, and you claim ITC only after that.

prompt: How should a travel agent's invoice of Rs 10,000 plus 18% GST be booked when ITC is eligible?
completion: Dr Travel expense 10,000, Dr Input CGST 900, Dr Input SGST 900 (or Dr Input IGST 1,800 if interstate), Cr Vendor 11,800. If ITC is blocked, debit the full Rs 11,800 to the expense.

prompt: Our school wants to know: is GST charged on tuition fees for classes 1 to 12?
completion: No. Services by an educational institution to students from pre-school up to higher secondary are exempt from GST. Fees for coaching or unrelated commercial services run by the school are not covered by this exemption.

prompt: हमारे क्लब ने निदेशक के लिए हेल्थ क्लब की सदस्यता ली है। क्या उसका ITC मिलेगा?
completion: नहीं। Section 17(5)(b)(iii) के तहत क्लब या हेल्थ और फिटनेस सेंटर की सदस्यता पर ITC ब्लॉक है, जब तक कानून नियोक्ता के लिए इसे अनिवार्य न बनाए। GST को खर्च में जोड़ें।
